root_cause_label: Name must match registered legal name
reasoning: The BE01 code indicates the beneficiary name does not match the account holder name. Memory M5 shows the same bank rejecting payments when the legal suffix is abbreviated (Pvt Ltd vs Private Limited). The current beneficiary name uses "Pvt Ltd", likely causing the mismatch.
recommended_action: Contact the client to verify the exact legal name registered with Tungabhadra Co‑operative Bank and request a resubmission with the full name (e.g., "Coorg Coffee Exports Private Limited").
draft_message:
Dear Arcadia Foods,

Your recent INR 1,511,000 payment to Coorg Coffee Exports was rejected (BE01) because the beneficiary name on the instruction ("Coorg Coffee Exports Pvt Ltd") does not match the account holder name on file. Please confirm the full legal name as registered with Tungabhadra Co‑operative Bank and resend the payment using that exact name.

Thank you.
prevention_tip: Always use the beneficiary's full legal name, including the correct suffix, as recorded by the receiving bank.

evidence.why_relevant: Same beneficiary bank (Tungabhadra Co-operative Bank) and same BE01 name‑mismatch rejection due to abbreviated suffix.
evidence.text: Payment EXC-260911-01 for INR 1,499,000.00 from Orchid Pharma Asia Pte Ltd to Deccan Bio Labs Pvt Ltd was rejected on 2026-09-11 by Tungabhadra Co-operative Bank due to a beneficiary name mismatch (reason code BE01), specifically an abbreviation instead of the registered legal name 'DECCAN BIO LABS PRIVATE LIMITED'.
